checks.name: actual_project_use
checks.result: The rebuilt MCP server appended an observation with explicit main and applied the exact source-ledger progress change in this project. Session and claim stayed unchanged, recovery snapshots match source bytes, and the final receipt resolves its attempt. Context is complete at 4989 tokens; Doctor reports only the intentionally active session.

checks.name: reviewed_ownership_boundaries
checks.result: Reviewed public Store privacy, event validation ordering and rollback, all live-process contender cleanup paths, TTL deadline and owner checks, branch selection, handoff/resume, retained checkpoint ownership and historical evidence visibility. These local coordination checks do not establish authentication or E4.

limitations: Local macOS component, concurrent OS process, CLI/MCP stdio and actual-project developer use. Cross-platform, M9 regression, E4, metrics and release gates remain separate.
SQL immutability covers configured Store connections and snapshots; it does not make an externally writable database file or removable trigger tamper-proof.
Branches preserve runtime provenance and claim ownership. Source projections and Git-managed files are shared; branch isolation is not local-user authentication or distributed locking.
The ignored fixture_contender helper is invoked explicitly only by the live-process tests. No model agent is called and no negative fixture modifies the actual project database.
